media:group.media:title: Closing the loop: research, production, recycling 🔋 | #shorts
media:group.media:description:
Our Cell Recycling Competence Center (CRCC) in Salching recovers valuable battery raw materials through our in-house developed direct recycling process – feeding them directly back into cell production at our pilot facility in Parsdorf.
Part of our Bavarian battery network where research, production, and recycling are all connected.

media:group.media:description:

media:group.media:title: Automated driving in production
media:group.media:description:
What began as a pilot in Dingolfing in 2022 is now an established production standard: our automated driving technology has completed one million vehicle movements across four plants. LiDAR, cloud infrastructure, and AI working together reliably, every day.
Watch our one-millionth automatically-driven vehicle drive through our Oxford plant.
#BMWGroup #BMWiFACTORY #production #innovation
